instruction: A candid documentary medium shot of a group of friends celebrating on a rooftop terrace during the day. On the left, a man with a hair bun (R5) in a black shirt is partially visible next to a Black man with glasses (R6) in a white t-shirt who leans in. Beside him, a blonde woman (R1) in a colorful striped dress smiles. In the center, a man in a white cap (R2) holds a cupcake with a lit candle. To his right, a woman in a black sleeveless top (R4) and a dark-haired woman (R3) in a striped top clap happily. On the far right, a woman with a curly afro (R7) in a striped dress smiles and claps. The group stands close together in bright daylight.
